description: This file contains helper functions and sorting logic for APIService objects in the Kubernetes API aggregation layer, including sorting by group and version, managing APIService conditions, and creating specific condition objects.

classes.name: ByGroupPriorityMinimum
classes.description: A type for sorting APIService objects by group priority and name.

classes.name: ByVersionPriority
classes.description: A type for sorting APIService objects by version priority and version string.

methods.name: SortedByGroupAndVersion
methods.description: Sorts APIService objects into groups and sorts each group by version.

methods.name: NewLocalAvailableAPIServiceCondition
methods.description: Creates a condition indicating local API services are always available.

methods.name: GetAPIServiceConditionByType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific condition from an APIService by type.

methods.name: SetAPIServiceCondition
methods.description: Sets or updates a condition on an APIService.

methods.name: IsAPIServiceConditionTrue
methods.description: Checks if a specific condition on an APIService is present and true.
